errors.evidence: The description fails to mention the title of the chart, 'Llama3-8B on Basketball', which is essential for understanding the context of the data.
The phrase 'стойността на въпроса' (the value of the question) is an ambiguous and inaccurate translation of 'Question Popularity'.
The tick marks on the X-axis are spaced at intervals of 2.5 units (5.0, 7.5, 10.0, etc.), not 5 units.
The starting value of the blue 'Accuracy' line at x=5.0 is 0.1, not 0.05. The stated value is off by 100%.
The final value of the green 'Confidence' line at x=25.0 is approximately 0.72, not 0.75.

errors.evidence: The red 'Alignment' line starts at a value of approximately 0.53 (not 0.50) and at x=7.5 has a value of approximately 0.54 (not 0.58).

The green line, representing 'Confidence', has triangle-shaped markers, it is not 'ohne Markierungen' (without markers).
